dog.description_text:
It’ll be smooth sailing with this tiny treasure! Say hello to Sail, an adorable 12.5 lbs, 1 year old who is very energetic and loves playing with toys.

Sail is super athletic, very curious, and always ready for action. He is friendly toward humans of all ages including kids, indifferent to dogs, and initially a bit bossy around other cats. He is overall easy to handle and doesn’t mind being picked up. He’s starting to appreciate being pet and responds well to human contact. This sweet boy is definitely blossoming more and more with each passing day!

Clean and tidy, Sail is fully litter-pan trained and has a healthy appetite. He also loves treats! When Sail is good and tired, he will curl up in a ball and find the coziest place to rest his head. He’s just the most darling thing everrr! Sail is a lot of fun to have around and will be an endless source of entertainment for his new furever family.

If you would like to adopt this wonderful cat, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
